moments.title: All-Female Top 6 on UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: For the first time since August 2023, the Official UK Singles Chart for September 25 - October 1 features an all-female top six, with Sienna Spiro holding the #1 spot.

angles.name: Girl Power Chart
angles.copy: Incredible news on the Official UK Singles Chart! For the first time in over three years, the entire top six is made up of female artists. Sienna Spiro is still leading the charge at #1! 👑

angles.name: Chart History Made
angles.copy: History repeats! The latest UK Singles Chart sees an all-female top six, a feat not seen since August 2023. Massive congrats to Sienna Spiro, Ella Langley, Stella Lefty, ADÉLA, Dua Lipa, and Olivia Rodrigo!

moments.title: Tribute to Venom's Cronos
moments.blurb: Conrad 'Cronos' Lant, frontman of influential UK heavy metal band Venom, sadly passed away yesterday at the age of 63, leaving a significant legacy in the metal genre.

angles.name: Metal Legend Remembered
angles.copy: Heartbreaking news for the metal world. Conrad 'Cronos' Lant, the legendary frontman of Newcastle's Venom, has passed away at 63. His impact on heavy music is immeasurable. Rest in power.

angles.name: Pioneering Sound
angles.copy: A true pioneer from the North East, Cronos of Venom shaped the sound of heavy metal for generations. We're sending our thoughts to his family and bandmates.

moments.title: Black History Month Begins

angles.name: Celebrating History
angles.copy: October 1st marks the start of Black History Month in the UK. Let's celebrate the rich history, achievements, and contributions of Black people to our nation and beyond.

angles.name: Educate and Engage
angles.copy: Throughout October, Black History Month provides an opportunity to educate ourselves and engage with the diverse stories that have shaped our society. Look out for events happening near you.

angles.name: Cost of Living Update

angles.name: Energy Bill Changes
angles.copy: Your energy bills might look a little different this month. The Ofgem price cap has increased, but VAT has been removed from domestic electricity. Stay informed on the latest UK money changes.
